reconstruction_criteria.requirement: recover candidate to selection to context to use to outcome/failure to revision/disposition links with exact source refs and fingerprints
mark absent selection, use, provenance, or revision links as unresolved
do not convert a candidate, outcome, or polished narrative into a complete history
preserve exact source reference, source SHA-256, locator, and synthetic boundary
retain confounders, open questions, and claim ceiling without causal or capability overclaim

ablation_criteria.requirement: do not call facts-only reconstruction method inheritance
do not complete broken trace links from plausibility
determine whether method trace condition supplies observable chain structure beyond facts-only
identify whether any method slot used is bound to supplied trace source

transfer_criteria.requirement: method selection in TRANSFER-01 is trace-bound and context-appropriate
application records expected observation, observed outcome or failure, unknowns, and evidence needed
reasoning is not accepted merely because it repeats template wording
synthetic case does not support general inheritance, capability, causation, R1, or canonical truth
